scope: Read-only source and JSON/manifest audit; no training, model execution, tests, seed changes or worker edits.

public_factory_path.initialization: Recipe.make_generator_optimizer and make_critic_optimizer invoke package Recipe._initialize_adam. Counter tensors and moments are allocated there before returning optimizer.
public_factory_path.snapshot_coverage: All active package files, added precision controller, worker, summarizer, protocol, evaluator and MLP are present in ZIP; declared hashes verify.

horizon_independence_static_audit.LR_control: ReversiblePrecision receives critic gradient disagreement and realized generator/prior update activity, not evaluator scores or target centers. Open/close choices are autonomous.
horizon_independence_static_audit.noise: Explicit fixed absolute initialization windows: input noise reaches zero after360 completed updates, output reaches.029 after720. These are bootstrap counts independent of evaluation budget/target timings, not absence of a noise schedule.
horizon_independence_static_audit.stopping: GANTrainer budget check disabled with total_steps=None.
horizon_independence_static_audit.verification_limit: Static source audit; checkpoint continuation and differing-budget execution are separate requirements.

configuration_distinction: API-RP2 is a new explicit public opt-in variant. Its CUDA eager zero-state initialization changes KA2 telemetry arithmetic and first-update state availability. Do not relabel default lazy/CPU-counter KA2 or inherit broader passes; numerical equality is only to the retained worker-mutated CUDA-eager diagnostic.
caveats: The legacy public LR helper functions still expect numeric total_steps; continuous trainer bypasses them, but helper compatibility is not complete.
Result LR maxima are seeded with base initialization rates rather than only applied rates; per-update logs are the authority.
Policy diagnostics still use variant=rp1 because RP2 reuses the RP1 controller; candidate identity requires recipe adam_eager_state=True as well.
Single-shift evidence is not stationary, delayed/repeated, long-term, checkpoint, matching-K3P or broader22 qualification.
conclusion: Public-constructor RP2 single shift supported; exact numeric replay of earlier eager diagnostic, with distinct explicit public configuration. No winner claim.
